title: First steps
summary: Your first hour in SkyRPG: the Skyhaven Chronicle tour, your first tools and your first coins.

s.x: You spawn in Skyhaven with nothing to do and a lot of friendly strangers. This page is a route through your first hour: which quests to take, who to meet, what to buy and where the first coins come from. Follow it and you will know every system you need for the survival world.

You appear on the Skyheart plaza, a little south of the golden fountain at the centre of the town. Nobody can hurt you here and nobody gets hungry. Take a minute to find your bearings with the minimap in the top right corner. Press
M
for the world map.
Press
K
to open the SkyRPG menu. The pages down the left are your Profile, Stats, Skills, Talents, Journal and more. See the
K menu
for all of them.
The questline is called the Skyhaven Chronicle. Every quest is a conversation with an NPC.
A gold
over an NPC means they have a quest for you.
A grey
means you are working on one of theirs.
A gold
means it is ready: go back and talk to them to hand it in.

Right-click the NPC to talk. Click a choice, press Space to skip the typing, or press the number on a choice. Stay close to the NPC while you talk. Esc closes the conversation, and you can pick it up again later. Details are on
Quests and the Journal
Chapter 1 has 11 quests and pays 600 coins and 165 SkyRPG XP in total. It is a tour of the town in this order.

rows.x: Talk to Hollis Barrowmead in the tavern
Open the Journal in the K menu
Visit the Provisioner at the Grand Bazaar
Visit the Banker at the Skyhaven Bank

s.x: Where each NPC stands is on
NPCs
. The Master quests hand you a tool each, so you finish chapter 1 with a stone pickaxe, axe, hoe and sword and a fishing rod.
Chapter 2 starts outside, in the survival world. It has 12 quests and pays 2,290 coins and 365 SkyRPG XP. It asks you to:
Attune a waystone (right-click a standing stone, for example by a village bell).
Gather 64 Stone and 24 Coal for Tamsin, 32 Oak for Oswin, and 16 Carrots for Mabel.
Reach Fishing level 3 and gather 10 Cod for Marina.
Defeat 5 zombies and 5 skeletons for Kestrel.
Reach Mining, Foraging and Combat level 2 for Hollis.
Reach Mining level 8 and craft a Delver Pickaxe at the Artisan Bench.
Get a pet (Odessa Quill gives you a pup egg) and bring it along.
The quest rewards give you a stone tool for every trade. Better ones cost coins or the trade's own currency.
Brannoc, Mabel, Oswin, Marina and Kestrel also each sell a four-piece starter armour set: Prospector, Harvester, Woodsman, Angler and Vanguard. Prices are on
Selling and shops
and
NPCs
You do not have to buy anything. The stone tools get you through chapter 1 and 2, and you can save for the upgrades at the Artisan Bench later. See
Crafting
Coins sit in your
purse
, shown in the top left. They are kept when you die. Early on they come from:
Quests.
Chapter 1 pays 600 coins and chapter 2 another 2,290.
Contracts.
Three shared contracts a day, in the K menu. Mine 300 stone, chop 128 logs or harvest 128 grown wheat and you get 500 coins and skill XP. See
Contracts
Selling.
Each Master buys the goods of their trade. A whole melon sells for 18, a pumpkin for 10, a mushroom for 10, a tropical fish for 20. Stone and logs are worth 1 and 2. See
Selling and shops
Elites.
Gold-named monsters in the survival world drop 50 to 200 coins and an Elite Trophy worth 250.
Events.
About every 60 to 90 minutes, when two or more players are on. See
Events
Contracts pay far better than selling the same materials. 300 stone sells for 300 coins, but the Stone Quota contract pays 500 coins and 300 Mining XP for the same job.
Put coins you do not need into the bank at the Skyhaven Bank. They earn 1% interest a day (up to 5,000). See
Coins and the bank
Press K and do chapter 1 (allow 15 to 20 minutes). Talk to everyone.
Open the Settings page once and glance at the HUD and Map options. See
Settings
Walk through the Wildgate with your stone tools and torches.
Do the chapter 2 gathering quests near the gate. Every one of them also levels a skill.
Come back by
/hub
or a waystone, hand the quests in and sell what you do not need.
Check the day's contracts in the K menu and take the ones you can finish.
Spend your first coins on the tool for the trade you like most.
Night in the survival world is dangerous. Mobs are levelled by distance from spawn, and monsters further out hit much harder. Stay close to the Wildgate until you have levelled a few skills. See
